acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:62945aae-.title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Platform
acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:62945aae-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Product Platform org - the group that powers product development across Vanta by building the shared foundations that every engineering team builds on top of. This hire will join one of two closely-aligned teams within the org, each working on foundational challenges with company-wide impact. Application Primitives is responsible for the shared, customer-facing platform components that product teams implement across the product: examples include comments, notifications platform, event log infrastructure, and agentic audit trails. This team sits at the intersection of platform and product - not pure infrastructure, not pure product - building the reusable building blocks that let other teams ship faster and more consistently. Libraries & Foundations is a brand-new team that owns Vanta's internal engineering libraries and golden-path patterns. Sitting between core platform and product platform in the stack, this team builds the TypeScript-first abstractions and shared foundations that all Vanta engineers build on top of - including event-driven architecture libraries, code quality tooling, and test frameworks. You'll be evaluated for both teams based on your background and interests, and the decision on team placement will reflect where your skills and passions are the strongest fit. Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on! What you’ll do as a Senior Software Engineer, Product Platform at Vanta: - Design and build high-quality, scalable systems and shared libraries that multiple engineering teams depend on - whether that's shared customer-facing components (Applications Primitives) or internal abstractions (Libraries & Foundations) - Partner deeply with product engineering teams to understand their needs and translate them into clean, well-documented APIs and services - Drive technical decisions and influence architecture across team boundaries, with a focus on developer experience and platform scalability - Define and uphold engineering standards for shared components, ensuring consistency, performance, and security across the systems you own - Participate actively in code review, design discussions, and technical planning - raising the engineering quality bar for your team and beyond - Write and maintain thorough documentation for the systems and libraries you build, enabling engineers across the org to use and contribute to them - Contribute to building Vanta's engineering culture as we scale How to be successful in this role: - Industry experience in backend or fullstack software engineering, with a focus on platform, shared infrastructure, or developer-facing systems - Experience building shared APIs, services, or platform components used by multiple engineering teams - a platform mindset is critical - Familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architecture, or message queue systems (Kafka, SQS, pub/sub) - Excellent communication skills - able to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and design stakeholders, and to clearly articulate technical trade-offs - Track record of shipping high-quality, maintainable code with sound judgment on architectural decisions - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:fdd65cb3-afd3-.title: Localisation Project Manager
bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:fdd65cb3-afd3-.description: We are looking for a Localisation Project Manager to join our in-house Localisation Team. In this role, you will support localisation initiatives across both Product and Marketing, helping ensure multilingual content is delivered efficiently, accurately, and on time. You will coordinate localisation projects across a variety of content types, working closely with stakeholders, freelancers, and localisation partners to support global experiences for our users. This is a hands-on role focused on project delivery, operational excellence, and process coordination. You will manage multiple localisation projects simultaneously, support the evolution of localisation workflows, and help ensure our content remains culturally relevant and high quality across markets. The ideal candidate is highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable navigating a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders and priorities.
responsibilities: Project Management
Coordinate the end-to-end localisation process for Product and Marketing initiatives.
Manage project timelines, priorities, and deliverables to ensure content is delivered on schedule and to a high quality standard.
Support localisation efforts across a range of content types, including product UI, feature launches, CRM, web content, paid media, and brand campaigns.
Monitor project progress and proactively identify and resolve risks, blockers, and delivery challenges.
Ensure localisation requests are appropriately scoped, planned, and communicated throughout the project lifecycle.
Stakeholder Collaboration
Partner with teams across Product, Content Design, Marketing, and Engineering to understand localisation requirements and delivery timelines.
Provide guidance on localisation processes, timelines, and best practices.
Act as a primary point of contact for localisation project coordination and communication.
Build strong relationships with stakeholders to support effective planning and execution.
Operations & Process Improvement
Identify opportunities to improve localisation workflows, tools, and processes.
Support the implementation of new workflows for emerging content types and business needs.
Maintain localisation documentation, workflow guides, and best practice resources.
Contribute to initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and quality across the localisation function.
Tools & Technology
Work with Translation Management Systems (TMS), content management platforms, and project management tools to coordinate localisation work.
Support automation and AI-assisted localisation workflows where appropriate.
Help improve localisation tooling, integrations, and operational processes.
Stay informed on localisation industry trends and emerging technologies.
qualifications: Required Experience
3-5+ years of experience in localisation, project management, content operations, or a related field.
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of localisation, transcreation, and cultural adaptation principles.
Experience working with Translation Management Systems (TMS) and project management tools.
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Knowledge of additional languages.
Nice to Have
Experience supporting both Product and Marketing localisation workflows.
Familiarity with software development and content creation processes.
Experience working with Jira, Asana, or similar project management tools.
Experience with multimedia localisation, including subtitles and video content.
Experience using AI-assisted localisation tools and automation workflows.
Degree in Localisation, Translation, Communications, Marketing, Linguistics, or equivalent practical experience.

With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. As a Staff Infrastructure Engineer, you will bridge the gap between development and operations, implementing automation and establishing best practices that enable our platform to scale efficiently while maintaining high availability. We are seeking Staff Infrastructure Engineers who are passionate about building and maintaining resilient systems at scale. Your mission will be to proactively find and analyze reliability problems across our stack, then design and implement software and systems to create step-function improvements. You will design robust monitoring solutions, automate operational tasks, and continuously improve our infrastructure's reliability, all while mentoring and educating the broader engineering team to make reliability a core value at Replit. REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: - 8-10 years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering or similar roles (DevOps, Systems Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering). - Strong programming skills in languages like Python or Go. - You write high-quality, well-tested code. - Deep understanding of distributed systems. You’ve designed, built, scaled, and maintained production services and know how to compose a service-oriented architecture. - Experience with container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) and cloud-native technologies. - Proven track record of implementing and maintaining monitoring/observability solutions, with strong skills in debugging and performance tuning. - Strong incident management skills with experience leading incident response and demonstrated critical thinking under pressure. - Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) and configurat

jobgether-jobgether:lever:1f409b78-dc16-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Maltese Voice Actor – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in United Kingdom. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Maltese voice professional to help shape the next generation of AI-powered voice technology. You will contribute your vocal expertise to training and evaluating advanced language and speech models. The role combines professional voice performance with linguistic evaluation, annotation, and AI-focused quality assessment. You will help improve how AI understands and reproduces Maltese pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotion, and regional variation. Working remotely, you will collaborate with a team using cutting-edge AI tools and evolving evaluation methods. Your contributions can help create more natural, accurate, and expressive voice experiences across a wide range of applications. This is a senior freelance opportunity for someone who wants to apply their Maltese voice expertise to the future of human-AI communication. Record high-quality scripted speech samples in Maltese for use in AI training and voice model development. Deliver clear, natural, expressive performances while maintaining accurate pronunciation, pacing, tone, and emotional nuance. Review and evaluate AI-generated speech outputs for linguistic accuracy, naturalness, pronunciation, and overall voice quality. Identify, annotate, and categorize errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated Maltese speech. Provide detailed expert feedback on pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, regional variation, and other relevant linguistic characteristics. Work with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation criteria, annotation approaches, and voice design guidelines. Apply professional voice and linguistic judgment consistently across a variety of recording and evaluation tasks. Help identify opportunities to improve the quality, authenticity, and cultural relevance of Maltese AI voice models. Maintain high standards of recording quality and follow technical and project-specific guidelines throughout the engagement. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in voice acting, dubbing, narration, broadcasting, or a closely related performance field in Maltese. Native-level or highly proficient Maltese language skills, with strong command of pronunciation, intonation, vocabulary, and natural spoken expression. Strong vocal control and the ability to communicate different tones, emotions, pacing, and styles authentically. Excellent listening and analytical skills, with the ability to identify subtle pronunciation, linguistic, and speech-quality issues. Exceptional attention to detail and consistency when reviewing recordings and AI-generated outputs. Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when providing structured feedback and annotations. Experience with linguistic annotation, language training, voice coaching, speech evaluation, or AI training projects is a plus. Comfortable learning and working with new AI tools, recording platforms, evaluation systems, and project workflows. Reliable, self-directed, and able to manage freelance work effectively in a remote environment. Access to a high-quality recording setup, including a reliable professional-grade microphone and a quiet, controlled recording environment. Secure computer equipment and a stable internet connection suitable for remote recording and AI-related project work. Benefits Freelance contract opportunity with a remote workplace setup . Our partner is looking for a Regional Account Manager based in United States. This is a strategic sales role focused on driving profitable growth across foodservice and retail channels. You will manage key customer relationships while identifying new opportunities across an expanding market. The role combines account management, business development, distributor and broker engagement, and channel strategy. You will work closely with internal teams on pricing, RFPs, product samples, forecasting, and customer requirements. Strong commercial judgment will be essential to balancing revenue growth, customer value, and margin objectives. The position offers broad exposure to national accounts, industry events, and evolving food market opportunities. With a remote setup and approximately 35–45% travel, this role is well suited to an accomplished relationship-driven sales professional. Develop and execute sales strategies designed to achieve revenue, profitability, and market-share objectives across foodservice, retail, and distributor channels. Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic accounts, including major food distributors, retail customers, and other high-value partners. southparkcommons-meesho:lever:9e5eca47-2.description: About the Team Being part of Meesho's Fulfillment and Experience (F&E) team, will zip you to the cockpit of our ever-burgeoning rocketship. And, you’ll shape the experience of Bharat’s next billion e-commerce users. We’re an eclectic mix of over 100 professionals, all driven by the first principles of problem-solving. We come with diverse skill sets and responsibilities ranging from running operations/support to managing the supply chain, and maintaining analytics. At Meesho, we’re trying to do what's never been done before – herald e-commerce into the tier-2, tier-3 cities of India. Our team’s role in this ambitious mission is to reimagine logistics from the ground up completely. This means a host of "zero-to-one" projects (takers, anyone?) to build a supply chain that reimagines e-commerce, not just in India but globally. We focus on personal growth and fun at work just as much as we do on working hard. That is why, we have regular 1-1s virtual meetings, fun-filled monthly all-team catch-ups, and timely rewards and recognitions About the Role As a Cluster Head - Security and Investigations at Meesho, you’ll run a Regional org focused on reducing Security incidents and identifying, reducing and resolving malicious losses and frauds on the ground. You’ll achieve it by forging strong collaborations with the Business and Operations teams, Operations partners and Sellers alike. You’ll work closely with the mentioned teams in order to serve our users better. To this end, you’ll also lead key initiatives, audits, formulating and implementing SOPs and deliver impactful projects to cater to security and loss prevention needs for the organization. Your guiding question in this role will be “How can we build an efficient, fraud-free, high on ownership and integrity supply chain, while keeping customer experience at max”. You’ll answer this question every day through owning the Security and Investigations charter for the Fulfillment and Experience, and Meesho at large.

strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:79784.description: Career Opportunity: Payroll Administrator with St. Xavier High School in Cincinnati, OH Do you enjoy owning the payroll process and serving as a trusted resource for employees? Are you experienced with payroll administration, benefits support, and compliance reporting? Do you enjoy working in a collaborative environment where you can build relationships, improve processes, and make an impact across the organization? If so, we'd like to hear from you. St. Xavier High School is seeking a Payroll Administrator to oversee payroll operations and support a variety of payroll, benefits, compliance, and employee support functions. This position works closely with Human Resources and the Business Office and plays an important role in supporting the faculty and staff who make St. Xavier's mission possible. The ideal candidate will bring strong payroll expertise, a customer-service mindset, and a desire to continuously improve processes and systems.
